html:
Smile is contagious. It opens minds, attracts people towards you and spreads like wildfire making this world a beautiful place. Smile generously and have an overall positive feeling about your surrounding. Things will be alright, it is meant to be alright so there is no point worrying for unknown or what cannot be controlled.

No worries of past about future came true and devastated you as you imagined them. You are still here and successful

You are not recognized as wise, intelligent or serious because you look serious. Your seriousness on face creates a boundary around you to the excellent opportunities to live as well as to grow. It creates a distance between you and your opportunity.

Smile makes you look beautiful.

Nature created you beautiful assuming you will smile often.

So just smile.
